summary: In Next.js 15, dynamic route parameters (params), searchParams, cookies(), and headers() are asynchronous Promises and must be awaited.
sourceTitle: Next.js 15 Release Notes & Async Request APIs RFC
sourceSection: Breaking Changes: Dynamic APIs are Asynchronous

contradiction.conflictingClaim: Hundreds of Next.js 13/14 tutorials access 'params.id' synchronously inside Server Components.
contradiction.officialClaim: Next.js 15 throws a build/runtime warning and halts synchronous params access to prepare for React 19 microtask scheduling.
contradiction.resolution: Resolved in Sanity Studio: Next.js 15 Async RFC is enforced across all modern server components.

replacementPattern: Direct async/await inside React Server Component
summary: getServerSideProps is invalid inside the app/ directory. Data fetching should be performed directly within async Server Components or via Route Handlers.

contradiction.conflictingClaim: ChatGPT frequently outputs 'export async function getServerSideProps' when asked to fetch data dynamically in Next.js.
contradiction.officialClaim: App Router completely ignores or errors out on getServerSideProps; components are natively async.
contradiction.resolution: Resolved in Sanity Studio: Prohibit Pages Router data-fetching primitives in app router files.

deprecatedPattern: const cookieStore = cookies(); const token = cookieStore.get('token');
replacementPattern: const cookieStore = await cookies(); const token = cookieStore.get('token');
summary: cookies() and headers() from 'next/headers' now return a Promise in Next.js 15.
